v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Fac benígne * in bona voluntáte tua, ut ædificéntur, Dómine, muri Ierúsalem.
text.en: O Lord, do good in thy good pleasure * unto Zion; to build the walls of Jerusalem.

text.la: Dóminus * mihi adiútor est, non timébo quid fáciat mihi homo.
text.en: The Lord is on my side; * I will not fear what can man do unto me.

text.la: Adhǽsit ánima mea * post te, Deus meus.
text.en: O my God, my soul cleaveth fast * after thee, O God.

text.la: Vim virtútis suæ * oblítus est ignis: ut púeri tui liberaréntur illǽsi.
text.en: The fire forgot his strength * that thy children might be delivered therefrom.

text.la: Sol et luna * laudáte Deum: quia exaltátum est nomen eius solíus.
text.en: Praise God, O ye sun and moon, * for His Name alone is exalted!

text.la: Fratres: Estóte imitatóres Dei, sicut fílii caríssimi: et ambuláte in dilectióne, sicut et Christus diléxit nos, et trádidit semetípsum pro nobis oblatiónem et hóstiam Deo in odórem suavitátis.
text.en: Be ye, therefore, followers of God, as most dear children; And walk in love, as Christ also hath loved us, and hath delivered himself for us, an oblation and a sacrifice to God for an odour of sweetness.

v.la: Ángelis suis Deus mandávit de te.
v.en: God hath given His Angels charge over thee.

r.la: Ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
r.en: To keep thee in all thy ways.

text.la: Cum fortis armátus * custódit átrium suum, in pace sunt ómnia quæ póssidet.
text.en: When a strong man armed keepeth his palace, * his goods are in peace.

text.la: Quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus, vota humílium réspice: atque ad defensiónem nostram, déxteram tuæ maiestátis exténde.
text.en: We beeseech thee, almighty God, look upon the hearty desires of thy humble servants, and stretch forth the right hand of thy Majesty to be our defense against all our enemies.
